title: Fictional beacon evidence exercise
text: This is a synthetic exercise, not the competition puzzle. Among Alder, Birch and Cedar, identify the west-coast beacon commissioned in 1984 and currently 32 metres tall. The candidate list is exhaustive for this exercise. The supplied records are authoritative only inside this fictional exercise.

constraints.description: The beacon is on the west coast.
Commissioning occurred in 1984, not merely refurbishment.
Exactly one of the three listed candidates meets every requirement.

sources.label: Fictional Alder record
sources.content: Alder: west coast; commissioned 1984; current height 28 metres.

sources.label: Fictional Birch record
sources.content: Birch: west coast; commissioned 1984; current height 32 metres.

sources.label: Fictional Cedar record
sources.content: Cedar: west coast; commissioned 1979; refurbished 1984; current height 32 metres.
